chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) enter the state of Ihram at night or during the day or at night? He said: Rather, during the day. I said: At which hour? He said: After the Dhuhr prayer.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended time to enter Ihram for Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the Sunnah timing for entering the state of Ihram, specifying that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) did so during the day after the Dhuhr prayer. This establishes a preferred temporal window for pilgrims, distinguishing it from night entry and aligning with the broader Islamic principle of performing major rituals during daylight hours for clarity and ease.
